verdict.rationale: Kommo is a SaaS CRM, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. The evidence covers APIs, the Web SDK, webhooks, marketplace integrations and llms.txt, but none of it mentions a public source repository or an open-source license. API and SDK access are developer building blocks, not open source code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
